subject: Invitation: SentryHealth case spotlight — operationalizing inference for clinical triage
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@sentryhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Invitation: SentryHealth case spotlight — operationalizing inference for clinical triage

Hi Elena,

Hope you’re doing well — it was great to connect at the HealthTech Summit last month. I’m reaching out from Redwood to invite SentryHealth to participate in a short, customer-led webinar we’re producing in September. The format is a 30-minute case spotlight (15 min customer, 10 min Redwood demo/Q&A) aimed at healthcare product and operations leaders.

Why we thought of SentryHealth: your team’s work on real-time triage routing using low-latency inference is exactly the kind of production story our audience wants to hear — especially the operational lessons (routing, latency SLOs, auditability).

High-level ask: would someone from your product/ops team be willing to present the customer side (15 minutes) and join a 10-minute joint Q&A with our solutions lead? We can handle speaker prep, slides editing, and a short pre-call to align.

Tentative dates: Tues, Sep 21 or Wed, Sep 22 (late-morning PT). We’ll make the session as low-friction as possible. I’ve attached a one‑page outline of the format and potential talking points.

Attachment: Sentry_Health_case_outline.pdf (pdf)

If you’re interested I can loop in our events lead and Marissa from marketing to coordinate. Thanks for considering — even a short quote on cost/latency improvements would be incredibly valuable.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Developer Marketing, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@sentryhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invitation: SentryHealth case spotlight — operationalizing inference for clinical triage

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks — we’d love to participate. Tom (cc’d) is our Head of Clinical Ops and would be the primary speaker. Sep 21 works best for us; Sep 22 is okay but we prefer the 21st.

Quick notes: we’d plan to highlight the production architecture, how we maintain 95th percentile latency under 150ms, and controls we put in place for auditability and data minimization. We can provide a short slide deck and a speaker bio.

Could you confirm: 1) final date/time window (PT), 2) exact session length (including Q&A), and 3) whether you need any legal approvals or an NDA for the slides? We typically run slides by our legal team for anything that mentions customers.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Director, Customer Success, SentryHealth
elena.soto@sentryhealth.com
cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@sentryhealth.com>
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@sentryhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation: SentryHealth case spotlight — operationalizing inference for clinical triage

Elena — wonderful, thanks for the quick reply and for looping Tom in.

Confirming details:
- Date/time: Tue, Sep 21, 2026, 10:30–11:00 AM PT (30-minute slot)
- Format: 15 minutes customer story, 10 minutes joint demo/Q&A, 5 minutes quick wrap + CTAs
- Prep: 30-minute speaker run-through one week prior (Tue, Sep 14) — Marissa will schedule.
- Legal: we do not require a new NDA for the slide deck; standard speaker slides are fine, but if SentryHealth wants us to keep anything redacted we’ll honor that. If you prefer, send materials to me and I’ll route to our legal team for a quick check.

Ben — forwarding so you can flag any success metrics we should call out on the promotion side (latency reduction, cost per inference, uptime improvements). Marissa — can you pick a run-through time on Sep 14?

Best,
Jasmine

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@sentryhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation: SentryHealth case spotlight — operationalizing inference for clinical triage

Hi team — excited to have SentryHealth join. Logistics on our side:

- Promo blurb: 2–3 sentence customer quote + 1 line description. Ben, can you provide one measurable stat we can include?
- Run-through: Tue, Sep 14, 9:00 AM PT (we’ll send a calendar invite).
- Slides: please share final slides by Fri, Sep 18 so we can co-brand and add event slide. We’ll respect redactions — if legal requests edits, we’ll handle the review quickly.
- Recording & assets: we’ll share the recording and a one-page recap with quotes for SentryHealth to use.

Elena/Tom — would you like us to suggest 3–4 audience questions to help shape the Q&A? We can also run a short prep doc (3 bullets) to keep the customer portion tight.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Events & Content, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@sentryhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@sentryhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 18:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invitation: SentryHealth case spotlight — operationalizing inference for clinical triage

Thanks all — confirming Sep 21 at 10:30 AM PT. Attached is a first-pass slide deck and a short speaker bio for Tom. We redacted any direct customer PII per legal request.

Attachments: Sentry_Live_Slides_v1.pptx (pptx), Tom_Reynolds_bio.txt (txt)

Quick note for Ben/Marissa: suggested measurable stat for promo: “Reduced median inference cost per triage decision by 48% while maintaining 95th percentile latency under 150ms.” Feel free to trim.

We’ll see you at the run-through on Sep 14.

Best,
Elena
Director, Customer Success, SentryHealth
